findings.evidence: Line 174 `mem_euclideanSection_iff : z ∈ euclideanSection d ↔ (z (Sum.inl 0)).re = 0 ∧ ∀ i, (z (Sum.inr i)).im = 0`; line 105 `ofMinkowski_apply : ofMinkowski v μ = (v μ : ℂ)`, so `(ofMinkowski v (Sum.inl 0)).re = v (Sum.inl 0)` and every `(ofMinkowski v (Sum.inr i)).im = 0`. Lines 254-255 discharge `hv` only by contradiction with `.spaceLike`, never using light-likeness itself.
findings.fix: Add `theorem ofMinkowski_mem_euclideanSection_iff {v : Vector d} : ofMinkowski v ∈ euclideanSection d ↔ v (Sum.inl 0) = 0` (one `simp [mem_euclideanSection_iff]`), and derive the two existing results from it; state the non-membership corollary as `causalCharacter v ≠ .spaceLike → v ≠ 0 → ofMinkowski v ∉ euclideanSection d`, keeping the light-like case as the roadmap-named specialisation.
findings.issue: `causalCharacter_eq_spaceLike_of_ofMinkowski_mem_euclideanSection` and `ofMinkowski_not_mem_euclideanSection` (line 251) sit below the natural level: the file's own `mem_euclideanSection_iff` (line 174) gives, for `z = ofMinkowski v`, the hypothesis-free characterisation `ofMinkowski v ∈ euclideanSection d ↔ v (Sum.inl 0) = 0` (the spatial-imaginary-part condition is vacuous since `(ofMinkowski v μ).im = 0`). The exported API instead offers only a weaker consequence guarded by `v ≠ 0`, and `ofMinkowski_not_mem_euclideanSection` further assumes `causalCharacter v = .lightLike` where the proof only needs `causalCharacter v ≠ .spaceLike` (nonzero timelike vectors have no Euclidean preimage by the identical argument). The sharp statement also matters downstream: it says the real points of the Euclidean section are exactly the equal-time slice, not the spacelike vectors, which is the converse Layer 0.4 will need and which the current wording invites a reader to assume.

summary: Statements are general in `d` and the special cases are properly derived from `complexMinkowskiProduct_continuation`. The exception is the pair of `ofMinkowski`-on-the-Euclidean-section results, which are stated well below the level the file's own `mem_euclideanSection_iff` already delivers.
